description: Scale native Hytale 0.7.2 terrain editing with per-operation ECS section pins, exact desired-state plans, preloaded surface variants and component-level region preservation. Reopen the preserved save and compare complete block, rotation, filler, entity and fluid snapshots.
changes: Release column and all ten section pins after each bounded operation instead of retaining the full landscape in memory.
Normalize native palette indices by stable asset names across server restarts.
Use already loaded Adaptive Surface variants and stock tree prefabs; do not register assets at runtime.
Generate complete desired block state before native application, pilot representative chunks and compare native readback.
Retain original root metadata and all section components except Block and BlockPhysics; update HeightmapColumn only.
When direct editing of the installed map is explicitly authorized, use one writer, fresh backups, zero-player authoring, and remove the temporary bridge after validation.
advantages: Validated at landscape scale without pinning every surveyed chunk simultaneously.
All original foreign chunk components and unselected region records retained.
Native readback catches multipart filler and ordering defects that visual plans cannot detect.
disadvantages: Only the installed Hytale 0.7.2 revision was validated.
A geometrically correct distant landscape can still exceed the client view-distance budget; actual screenshots are a separate acceptance step.
Single screenshots and 60 FPS overlays are not a controlled performance benchmark.
test_results: Second pass: 107058190 changed cells across 1896 chunks; 621281280 cells compared after save and after reopening, with zero errors.
2199 unselected existing chunk records byte-identical; 113760 original foreign section components retained.
Three scenic villages with 19 houses, native tree prefabs and 102539 terrain Adaptive Surface variants were persisted.
A two-chunk tall-grass pilot initially failed; replacement with the verified single-cell native lush tall grass passed, followed by full save/reopen validation.

metrics.reliability: Native complete-state and selective-preservation checks passed; client visual acceptance is tracked separately.
